qs.s: Il porte un manteau ___ aujourd'hui.
qs.en: He is wearing a grey coat today.

qs.en: The sky is grey this morning, it might rain.

qs.en: The atmosphere in the office has been gloomy since the announcement of layoffs.

qs.en: He leads a dull, joyless life.

qs.en: His grey eyes seemed sad to me.

qs.en: He was wearing grey gloves matching his suit.

qs.en: She bought a grey dress for the ceremony.

qs.en: The grey mouse is hiding behind the sideboard.

qs.s: Les pierres ___ du vieux château brillaient sous la pluie.
qs.en: The grey stones of the old castle gleamed in the rain.

qs.s: J'ai trouvé deux chaussettes ___ dans le tiroir.
qs.en: I found two grey socks in the drawer.

qs.s: Ce fauteuil est si confortable qu'on s'y sent tout de suite à l'___.
qs.en: This armchair is so comfortable that one immediately feels at ease in it.

qs.en: Children need space to play comfortably without feeling cramped.

qs.s: Je suis ___ de vous annoncer que votre candidature a été retenue.
qs.en: I am pleased to inform you that your application has been accepted.

qs.s: Nous sommes ___ d'apprendre que tout s'est bien passé.
qs.en: We are delighted to learn that everything went well.

qs.s: Elle prend ses ___ et fait toujours exactement ce qui lui plaît.
qs.en: She makes herself at home and always does exactly what pleases her.

qs.s: Il se sentait à son ___ dans cette petite ville tranquille où il n'avait pas à se forcer.
qs.en: He felt completely free and at ease in that quiet little town where he didn't have to make an effort.

qs.s: Les deux hommes semblaient ___ dans leurs nouveaux costumes.
qs.en: The two men seemed comfortable in their new suits.

qs.en: My male colleagues declared themselves pleased to work in this new environment.

qs.en: Marie is pleased to see her childhood friends again after so many years.

qs.en: The director was pleased to announce the good results to her team.

qs.s: Les deux sœurs étaient ___ de rentrer enfin dans leur maison natale.
qs.en: The two sisters were pleased to finally return to their childhood home.

qs.s: Ces femmes se disaient ___ de pouvoir s'exprimer librement lors du débat.
qs.en: These women said they were pleased to be able to express themselves freely during the debate.

qs.s: Ce comportement constitue une ___ caractérisée contre la vie privée.
qs.en: This behavior constitutes a clear violation of privacy.

qs.s: Le tribunal a condamné l'accusé pour ___ sexuelle.
qs.en: The court convicted the accused of sexual violation.

qs.s: Elle a été victime d'une ___ dans la rue hier soir.
qs.en: She was the victim of an assault in the street last night.

qs.s: La police enquête sur une ___ à main armée commise dans le quartier.
qs.en: The police are investigating an armed assault committed in the neighborhood.

qs.s: L'armée a repoussé l'___ ennemie à la frontière.
qs.en: The army repelled the enemy attack at the border.

qs.s: Son discours était perçu comme une ___ verbale envers ses collègues.
qs.en: His speech was perceived as a verbal attack against his colleagues.

qs.s: ___ agression dont il a été victime l'a profondément traumatisé.
qs.en: The assault he suffered deeply traumatized him.

qs.s: C'est ___ agression grave que le tribunal doit sanctionner sévèrement.
qs.en: It is a serious assault that the court must punish severely.
